## Problem

Describe the problem (concisely).

## Steps to reproduce

```
nvim --clean -u repro.lua
```

```lua
vim.o.swapfile = false
vim.o.shadafile = 'NONE'
local api = vim.api
vim.o.ch = vim.o.lines
api.nvim_open_win(1, true, {
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  row = 10,
  col = 10,
  hide = true,
  noautocmd = false,
  border = 'rounded',
  relative = 'editor',
})
api.nvim_open_term(1, {})

```
